content: Service workers are only available in secure contexts : this means that their document is served over HTTPS, although browsers also treat http://localhost as a secure context, to facilitate local development.
conclusion: MDN官方规范明确Service Worker仅在安全上下文（HTTPS或http://localhost）中可用，file://与普通HTTP不支持注册运行Service Worker，纯前端离线重启需依赖该安全上下文。
